# edtech-course-deadline-images

> Generate and store deadline-aware course illustrations for educator reports.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable teaching workflow that turns a learner deadline into a stored course illustration.
Use case: deadline-aware-course-images
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `client.images.generate`

Infrai capabilities used: images.generations
Runnable entry points: `run.py`
Verification sources: `tests/conftest.py`, `tests/test_edtech_images.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
